title: Fred & Friends Dinner Winner kids trays
text:
Fred & Friends Dinner Winner kids trays. These are a big hit with my 2 and 5 year old grandsons... I usually put a mini hersey's bar at the "end" surprise.. but they are just as happy with a couple of m & m's or marshmallows. I tried a sliced strawberry once, that didn't get quite as good a response, but they ate it. :) Honestly, it's hard to get the 5 year old to be interested in food, while the 2 year old needs to do everything the 5 year old does, thus I needed 2. I think the price is too high for what they are... but obviously I did it. It's nice to have something "different" at grandmas house. I never hesitate to update my reviews with important info should anything come up and I will do so here. So far, they are have washed up nicely. While they can be washed on the top rack of the dishwasher, I have been hand washing them.
UPDATE: 5/22/2016.... I could have been more "helpful" by including some usable info... Each plate is about 9" x 6" .. the lip of each tray is around 1/2" ... I am eyeballing this measurements... I continue to hand wash them with ease. They are fairly weighty for plastic. If there is any other info that would be helpful I always respond to questions/comments.
